name: capacities-mcp-server
description: Capacities v2 knowledge management integration: search, object CRUD, weblink capture, and daily notes. Runs on the Capacities v2 REST API.

capacities_api_token.title: Capacities API Token
capacities_api_token.description: Your Capacities v2 API token (cap-api-…) from the Capacities Desktop App → Settings → API. Scoped to a single space.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search objects by title across your Capacities space (optional structure filter and limit)

tools.name: find_objects
tools.description: Locate objects by a property/date/label/tag the API cannot search on — title-seed search, then client-side filter/sort over typed property values (returns ids+titles+values, no bodies)

tools.name: list_spaces
tools.description: List the single space your API token is scoped to

tools.name: get_space_info
tools.description: Get the space's structures with property ids, types, writability, label options, and relation targets

tools.name: create_object
tools.description: Create a typed object of any structure; properties/labels/relations set by name (strict), optional markdown body

tools.name: update_object
tools.description: Update a structured object's properties/labels/relations (replaces the value of each named property)

tools.name: get_object
tools.description: Read an object's content as markdown

tools.name: append_to_object
tools.description: Append markdown to an object's body (supports () tasks, #tags, [[links]])

tools.name: delete_object
tools.description: Move an object to trash (recoverable in Capacities)

tools.name: save_weblink
tools.description: Save a URL as a Weblink object; auto-fetches title/description, with optional overrides and notes

tools.name: add_to_daily_note
tools.description: Append markdown to today's daily note
